title: Show HN: Audionaut – an open-source cross-platform multitrack audio editor
summary: Audionaut is an open-source, cross-platform multitrack audio editor that provides free audio recording, editing, and mixing capabilities. Built as a modern alternative to expensive commercial DAWs, it aims to make professional audio production accessible to everyone.
problem_solved: Provides a free, open-source alternative to expensive proprietary multitrack audio editing software like Pro Tools or Logic Pro.
why_valuable: Democratizes audio production by offering cross-platform compatibility and source accessibility without licensing costs, enabling musicians and creators to work with professional-grade tools.
